definitions.ask: If the first note isn't open but the active tab is an empty New tab, fill that tab instead of appending one?
definitions.why: A blank tab holds nothing, and the usual one (all tabs closed) is already the far right

choices.label: The note fills the blank tab in place; no stray blank tab, but it can land mid-strip
The note always opens at the far right; the blank tab stays where it was
